clips.title: The story
paras: Offered by Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell, this quest tasks Forsaken adventurers with rescuing newly raised undead trapped in Night's Web Hollow. It highlights the delicate relationship between undead wielders of the Holy Light and a populace that deeply distrusts them. By aiding their fallen kin, these holy practitioners hope to prove their loyalty to Sylvanas and the Forsaken cause.

The Holy Light is notoriously agonizing and hazardous to the undead, yet some Forsaken retain their connection to the sacred magic they wielded in life. In Deathknell, figures like Aramis Hammerhand strive to demonstrate that their faith has not turned them against their people. To combat the suspicion that holy practitioners will turn on other undead as monstrosities, they actively use their abilities and compassion to safeguard their kin.

Northwest of Deathknell lies Night's Web Hollow, a dank cavern crawling with vicious spiders. Freshly raised undead, still disoriented by their awakening and lacking the wits to defend themselves, frequently stumble into the hollow and end up cocooned in sticky webbing. Rescuing these unfortunate Forsaken serves a dual purpose: saving new recruits for the Dark Lady and proving to leaders like Executor Arren that practitioners of the Light are devoted servants of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.
This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
Then they will see our nature.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?

clips.title: Completion
paras: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.
They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.
